worldcombat.skill.aquajet.summary: Wrap yourself in a jet of water and shoot along the ground: further and longer than Quick Attack, soaking and shoving the first body it strikes and putting out any fire on it. A user already in water jets harder. The deluge form pierces the whole path and soaks everyone it touches, at a lighter hit each.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.use.0: Open from range and drench the target
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.use.1: Close the distance with a water-powered rush
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.use.2: Jet out of the water for a harder column
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.description.0: The jet deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.description.1: Shoot up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick; a landed hit shoves the target about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.description.2: Soak the target for %1$s on hit.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.deluge.on: Deluge: the column pierces the whole path, soaking and striking everyone it touches, with a wider hit and a longer soak, at 0.82 damage per hit and 6 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.deluge.off: Single torpedo: it stops on the first body, hits hardest and cools down sooner, for punching through one target.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.growth.0: At level %1$s the jet rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.growth.1: At level %1$s the jet rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.aquajet.preference.del: On: the column pierces the whole path, soaking and striking everyone it touches, with a wider hit and a longer soak, at 0.82 damage per hit and 6 ticks more cooldown. Off: a single torpedo that stops on the first body and hits hardest.
It only jets at targets within this distance; this reaches further than Quick Attack, so larger values let it open sooner.
On: rank a target already carrying soaked last, so it drenches a dry one. Off: treat it as an ordinary first-strike candidate.
On: lowers priority against burned enemies to preserve ongoing damage. Pushback and finishing attacks remain available. Off: ranks by ordinary attack value.
